excerpt:
The open source integration management layer for AI. Executor.sh is an MCP gateway that allows you to sign in once to all of your integrations and use them with any client.

We enable you to connect your agents to anything (MCP, GraphQL, OpenAPI) so regardless of what you're trying to connect agents to you're able to.

If you're trying to scale agents to access all of your production services, data, etc, you need Executor as a unified management layer. Reported team size: 1.

Claude Code Cursor Codex SentryOpenAPI GitHubGraphQL LinearMCP For humans For agents Run locally →Try Cloud Set up with your agentRead docs Wiring tools to agents is fiddly, per-client, and easy to get wrong. Executor makes every tool, from any protocol, look the same: one name, one input schema, one output schema, so any agent can call any of them the same way. Context efficiency Thousands of tools, no bloat. Connect everything you use and Executor still shows the model a single tool. It searches your catalog and loads a tool's schema only when the code actually calls it, so the prompt never balloons. Without Executor: 1,640 tools, about 278,800 tokens. With Executor: 1 tool, about 1,044 tokens.
